subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about winning back the shoppers who browse a SKU, drop off, and never check out at {Brand}. The one point worth repeating: we optimize the engine to the purchase, the completed and paid order, read back through a server-to-server postback fired from your stack before it counts, with already-purchased buyers suppressed so we do not burn margin re-serving a converter. On the retargeting line that has been landing around 4.1x ROAS. If it helps, I can pull the recency-segment read on your abandoned baskets. Worth a short look?
illustrative_flags: 4.1x ROAS on the retargeting line (MobUpps-specific, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ecommerce retargeting South Africa, native English (no transliteration). References prior outreach in first sentence (browse/drop-off/never-checkout from parent). Restates single proof: purchase optimization + S2S postback + already-purchased suppression. One illustrative MobUpps figure (4.1x ROAS), never established fact. Soft CTA, exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no curly quotes; no hedge before a number; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation.
